projects.name: matchai
projects.description: matchai is an indev platform to help manage all the information in your daily life. Customizable widgets from daily tasks, workouts, mood logging, calendar events, and more are all intergrated and can be changed, reordered to however you desire.

projects.name: wayvilo
projects.description: wayvilo was a washington metro transit pwa that allowed riders to plan their trip in advance through a delightful user interface and helpful information including navigation, delays, and average train headways. it functioned similarly to the app transit or apple maps, but tailored to just wmata's system. while the project has not received any recent developments, i am planning to design and developing another transit app in the near future!

projects.name: pask
projects.description: pask was a submission for the wwdc25 swift student challenge submission that aimed to teach the basics of personal online security in an engaging, gamified way, drawing inspiration from apps like duolingo.
